sample_unit: questions (English and Chinese) about chronic hepatitis B

links.outcome: Language-stratified performance of ChatGPT responses to CHB questions (English vs Chinese)
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 performed better in English, particularly in informativeness and consistency across repeated queries; ChatGPT-4.0 overcame the language impact on information accuracy.
links.quote: Notably, superior performance was evident in English, particularly in terms of informativeness and consistency across repeated queries.

links.outcome: Accuracy of generative AI on true-or-false CHB questions by model and language
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 accuracy 93.3% (168/180) vs ChatGPT-3.5 65.0% (117/180), P<.001; GPT-4.0 overcame language impact on accuracy.
links.quote: When responding to true-or-false questions, ChatGPT-4.0 achieved an accuracy rate of 93.3% (168/180), significantly surpassing ChatGPT-3.5's accuracy rate of 65.0% (117/180) (P<.001).

unlisted_practices: Providing emotional management guidance in LLM responses to chronic disease patients
Assessing disclaimer inclusion in chatbot responses to medical questions

screen.reason: The study tests the performance of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4.0 on chronic hepatitis B patient inquiries across English and Chinese using expert physician grading, but it does not compare or evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
